title: Explicit termwise pushforward functor is fully faithful
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], T_n a tower of schemes with i_n:T_n→T_(n+1), j_n:T_n→X, hi_n:i_n≫j_(n+1)=j_n, and specified tensor pullback adjunctions ai_n [def-pc-module-pullback]. For coherent thickening systems [def-weil-pbc-coherent-thickening-system], construct P(M)_n=j_(n,*)M_n and the adjacent map as j_(n+1,*) of the ai_n-adjoint of M.comparison n followed by pushforward composition and hi_n. This defines a functor to inverse systems, with evaluation naturally equal to termwise pushforward. If every j_n is a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion], this explicit functor is full and faithful.

proof.text: Define the adjacent morphism by applying ai_n.homEquiv to the comparison and then pushforward and the canonical composition/congruence isomorphisms. Use Functor.ofOpSequence to define all longer transitions by composition. Data are explicit.

Apply the adjunction hom equivalence to a compatible family equation. Naturality of homEquiv and of the pushforward comparison makes the pushed components commute with adjacent transitions. NatTrans.ofOpSequence extends to all transitions. Identities and composition hold componentwise by the pushforward functor laws. Evaluation has the identity natural isomorphism and the adjacent-map formula is ofOpSequence_map_homOfLE_succ.

For closed j_n, each pushed component map has a unique preimage by closedImmersion_pushforward_fullyFaithful. Cancel the pushforward comparison, apply faithfulness of j_(n+1),* and injectivity of ai_n.homEquiv to show the preimages satisfy pullback comparison compatibility. Thus they form an arrow of thickening systems mapping to the given natural transformation. Equality of pushed arrows implies equality of all components, hence equality of compatible families. This proves Full and Faithful.
